title: UpdateUserRequest
description:
Updates to be made to a user. Only the fields provided in the request are updated.

To update the user's name, provide the `name` object with `display_name`, `first_name`, and `last_name`.

To update the user's SAML name ID, provide the `saml_account` object with both `idp_issuer` and `name_id`. The `idp_issuer` must match the user's current identity provider (it acts as a guard and can't be changed with this API, so only `name_id` is updated).

locale.description: The locale of the user, as an IETF BCP 47 language tag. Must be a supported language.

SamlAccount.description: The SAML account details used to link the user to the organization's identity provider for SSO.

idp_issuer.description: The issuer id or entity id of the SAML identity provider. Often a unique URL, but not always. Must resolve to an identity provider owned by the caller's organization.

name_id.description: The SAML NameID that identifies the user to the identity provider. This value is case sensitive, and shouldn't change.

UserNameUpdate.description: The name fields to update for the user.

display_name.description: The display name of the user.

first_name.description: The first name of the user. Set to an empty string to clear the first name.

last_name.description: The last name of the user. Set to an empty string to clear the last name.
